instructions: Heat a large pot over medium heat. Add the beef and 1/4 tsp of the salt. Cook, breaking it into small pieces with a spoon, until no pink is left, 6 to 8 minutes.
Transfer the beef to a bowl with a slotted spoon. Spoon all but a teaspoon of the fat out of the pot.

Chop the onion, shred the carrot on the big holes of a grater and dice the celery. Melt 1 tbsp of the butter in the same pot over medium heat. Add the onion, carrot, celery, basil and parsley flakes. Cook, stirring now and then, until soft, about 10 minutes.

Peel the potatoes and cut them into 1/2 inch cubes. Add them to the pot with the broth and the beef. Bring to a boil, then turn the heat down, cover and simmer for 10 to 12 minutes, until a fork slides into a potato.
Meanwhile, melt the remaining 2 tbsp butter in a small skillet over medium heat. Stir in the flour and cook, stirring, until it bubbles, 3 to 5 minutes.
Stir the flour mixture into the soup and bring it to a boil. Cook, stirring, for 2 minutes, until the soup thickens.

Turn the heat to low. Cut the Velveeta cheese into cubes and add it with the milk, the remaining 1/4 tsp salt and the pepper. Stir until the cheese melts, about 3 minutes. Keep it at a gentle steam and don't let it boil.
Take the pot off the heat, then stir in the sour cream. Boiling it can make the soup curdle.
Taste it. If it's flat, add a pinch more salt.
Ladle into bowls. Leftovers keep in the fridge for up to 3 days. Reheat over low heat with a splash of milk.
method_notes: Lead is Taste of Home's cheeseburger soup, the most rated version found (699 ratings), but the page shows only a star icon, so its average could not be read; it is used as a fallback lead. Six Sisters' Stuff (5.0 from 3) follows the same method with a full pound of beef. Both build the soup the same way: vegetables softened, potatoes simmered in broth, a butter and flour roux, then Velveeta, milk and sour cream off the boil. This version is halved to serve 4, with 12 oz of beef (the original uses half a pound for 8). Other versions (Budget Bytes, The Recipe Critic) block the reader.
